ReportQueryDefinition.Name: Реестр почтовых переводов ф.112эп
ReportQueryDefinition.Command: SELECT m.id, m.declared_value AS transfer_amount, c.name AS recipient_fio, c.passport_series AS pass_ser, c.passport_number AS pass_num, c.passport_issued_by AS pass_whowhen, c.bik, c.rs, c.ks, c.bank_name, s.name AS sender_fio, s.inn AS sender_inn FROM mails m JOIN counterparties c ON m.counterparty_id = c.id JOIN counterparties s ON m.sender_id = s.id WHERE m.id = :MailId;

SELECT m.id, m.declared_value AS transfer_amount, c.name AS recipient_fio, c.passport_series AS pass_ser, c.passport_number AS pass_num, c.passport_issued_by AS pass_whowhen, c.bik, c.rs, c.ks, c.bank_name, s.name AS sender_fio, s.inn AS sender_inn FROM mails m JOIN counterparties c ON m.counterparty_id = c.id JOIN counterparties s ON m.sender_id = s.id WHERE m.id = :MailId;
